ui.splitVideosLongerThan30MinutesInto: Split videos longer than 30 minutes into segments for parallel transcription
ui.prebuiltFasterWhisperProgramsNoPython: Prebuilt faster-whisper programs; no Python setup required. The GPU version includes CUDA dependencies.
ui.downloadATranscriptionProgramFirstThe: Download a transcription program first. The GPU version is recommended for faster transcription on NVIDIA GPUs.
ui.tauDownloadsTheRuntimeForThisDevice: Tau downloads the runtime for this device on first use. No manual Python setup is required.
ui.downloadItAgainToUseItAfter: Download it again to use it after deletion.
ui.voiceInputIsUnavailableOnDesktopSo: Voice input is unavailable on desktop, so this selection is not used here. On your phone, configure it under Me › Voice input.
ui.useRealTimeSystemRecognitionRecording: Use real-time system recognition; recordings stay on this device
ui.cloudRecognitionRecordingsAreSentToTh: Cloud recognition · Recordings are sent to this service
ui.theSelectedRecognitionPluginIsDisable: The selected recognition plugin is disabled or uninstalled. Its configuration is retained. Enable it again or choose system recognition.
ui.installASpeechRecognitionPluginSuchAs: Install a speech recognition plugin, such as Doubao Speech, to configure a cloud recognition account here.
ui.configureTheAccountAndRecognitionMode: Configure the account and recognition model on the plugin page, then return here to select it
ui.addPunctuationAndRemoveRepeatedSpeech: Add punctuation and remove repeated speech while preserving meaning. Clear the model assignment to turn this off.
ui.offAssignAModelToVoiceInput: Off: assign a model to Voice input cleanup under Language models › Feature assignments
ui.optionalForExampleKeepEnglishAbbrevia: Optional, for example keep English abbreviations; up to 1000 characters
